StoryInit
passages.source_raw:
/* Set Game System Variable */
	<<set $game = {
		release: "Public Build",
		version: 5.1200003,
		Version: "5.12"
		}>>

	/* Toggle specific testing flags */
	<<set $DebugMessages to false>>
	<<set $PitTesting to false>>
	<<set $ArtDemo to false>>
	<<set $DevDigest to false>>
	
	/* Settings changed for Testing Modes */
	<<if $PitTesting is true>>
		<<set $game.release to "Dev Build">>
		<<set $DebugMessages to true>>
	<</if>>
	<<if $DevDigest is true>>
		<<set $UseArt to true>>
		<<set $game.release to "Dev Build">>
	<</if>>
	<<if $ArtDemo is true>>
		<<set $UseArt = true>>
		<<set $game.release to "Art Release - ">>
		<<set $game.Version to "1">>
	<<else>>
		<<set $UseArt = false>>
	<</if>>
	
	<<script>>
		config.saves.version = state.variables.game.version;
		config.saves.autosave = "autosave";
	<</script>>

passages.name: UpdateCheck
passages.source_raw:
<<widget "UpdateCheck">>
        <<if $game.version < 5.0900006>>
            <<set $game.version to 5.0900006, $game.Version to "5.9", $game.release to "Public Build">>
        <</if>>
        <<if $game.version < 5.0901001>>
            <<set $game.version to 5.0901001, $game.Version to "5.9.1.1", $game.release to "Dev Build">>
            <<if dose($penny,"serumDiaries")>>
                <<set $penny.mcsNotes to []>>
                <<set $penny.mcsNotesNew to false>>
                <<set $penny.mcsTimer to 1>>
            <</if>>
        <</if>>
        <<if $game.version < 5.0901002>>
            <<set $game.version to 5.0901002, $game.Version to "5.9.1.2", $game.release to "Dev Build">>
            <<if $penny.isMouse>>
                <<AddConvo $sophie 13>>
                <<AddConvo $penny 32>>
                <<AddWorkEvent 78>>
            <</if>>
        <</if>>
        <<if $game.version < 5.0901004>>
            <<set $game.version to 5.0901004, $game.Version to "5.9.1", $game.release to "Public Build">>
            <<set $penny.mcsx to {}>>
            <<set $penny.mcsx.cd to 0>>
        <</if>>
        <<if $game.version < 5.1200003>>
            <<set $game.version to 5.1200003, $game.Version to "5.12", $game.release to "Public Build">>
            <<set $saya.default to null>>
        <</if>>
    <</widget>>

passages.name: PassageDone
passages.source_raw:
<<if passage() isnot "Start">>
	<<UpdateCheck>>
	<<StatReset>>
	<<GenderCheck>>
	<<EventsCheck>>
	<<DreamCheck>>
	<<if $Chapter > 0 or visited("Intro-ChapterStart")>>
		<<HornyCheckValue>>
	<</if>>
	<<set $NoStaticEvent to false>>
	<<set $c = 0,$c2 = 0>>
	<<set $EVENT to [], $EVENTR to 0>>
	<<set $PNAME to $player.name>>
	<<set $achievementTrigger to false>>
	<<updatebar>>
<</if>>

passages.name: PassageHeader
passages.source_raw:
<<if passage() isnot "Start">>
    /* Beginner Chemist - Make MCS-1 */
    <<if $serum[1].qty > 0>>
        <<achieve 1>>
    <</if>>

    /* Intermediate Chemist - Make MCS-2 */
    <<if $serum[2].qty > 0>>
        <<achieve 2>>
    <</if>>

    /* Advanced Chemist - Make MCS-3 */
    <<if $serum[3].qty > 0>>
        <<achieve 3>>
    <</if>>

    /* Bad Ender - Make MCS-X */
    <<if $serum[7].qty > 0>>
        <<achieve 4>>
    <</if>>

    /* Complete Chapter 1 */
    <<if $Chapter > 1>>
        <<achieve 5>>
    <</if>>

    /* Complete Chapter 2 */
    <<if $Chapter > 2>>
        <<achieve 6>>
    <</if>>

    /* Complete Chapter 3 */
    <<if $Chapter > 3>>
        <<achieve 15>>
    <</if>>

    /* Create CMD-1 in Chapter 1 */
    <<if $Tasks[1].complete>>
        <<achieve 7>>
    <</if>>

    /* Dose Ava */
    <<if $mom.dose > 0>>
        <<achieve 8>>
    <</if>>

    /* Dose Dakota */
    <<if $sister.dose > 0>>
        <<achieve 9>>
    <</if>>

    /* Dose Penny */
    <<if $penny.dose > 0>>
        <<achieve 10>>
    <</if>>

    /* Dose Tasha */
    <<if $tasha.dose > 0>>
        <<achieve 11>>
    <</if>>

    /* Dose Diana */
    <<if $diana.dose > 0>>
        <<achieve 12>>
    <</if>>

    /* Dose John */
    <<if $john.dose > 0>>
        <<achieve 13>>
    <</if>>

    /* John Doses You */
    <<if $john.isDom>>
        <<achieve 14>>
    <</if>>

    /* Unlock AmazingAss Trait */
    <<if tracked($player,"analFuck.get",10)>>
        <<achieve 16>>
    <</if>>

    /* Unlock Oral Master Trait */
    <<if tracked($player,"oral",20)>>
        <<achieve 17>>
    <</if>>

    /* Unlock Oral Fanatic Trait */
    <<if tracked($player,"oral",40)>>
        <<achieve 18>>
    <</if>>

    /* Unlock Bimbo Trait */
    <<if $player.daysBimbo >= 10>>

    <</if>>

    /* Unlock Masculinity Lover Trait */

<</if>>

passages.name: PassageReady
passages.source_raw:
<<if passage() isnot "Start">>
	<<UpdateCheck>>
	<<StatReset>>
	<<GetTimeInfo>>
	<<GenderCheck>>
	<<GetGameState>>
	<<if $Chapter > 0 or visited("Intro-ChapterStart")>>
		<<HornyCheckValue>>
	<</if>>

	<<set _dbgC = $c, _dbgC2 = $c2>>

	<<if not $UseDoseCD>>
		<<if $mom.doseCD > 1>>
			<<set $mom.doseCD to 1>>
		<</if>>
		<<if $sister.doseCD > 1>>
			<<set $sister.doseCD to 1>>
		<</if>>
		<<if $sophie.doseCD > 1>>
			<<set $sophie.doseCD to 1>>
		<</if>>
		<<if $tasha.doseCD > 1>>
			<<set $tasha.doseCD to 1>>
		<</if>>
		<<if $diana.doseCD > 1>>
			<<set $diana.doseCD to 1>>
		<</if>>
		<<if $julia.doseCD > 1>>
			<<set $julia.doseCD to 1>>
		<</if>>
	<</if>>
	<<updatebar>>
	<<unset $SceneCredit>>

	<<if $ShowImages and $ShowWeather>>
		<<if $story.halloweenEventActive>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_redalert">>
		<<elseif isMorning()>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_morning">>
		<<elseif isLateMorning()>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_latemorning">>
		<<elseif isNoon()>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_noon">>
		<<elseif isEarlyAfternoon()>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_earlyafternoon">>
		<<elseif isAfternoon()>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_afternoon">>
		<<elseif isEvening()>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_evening">>
		<<elseif isNight()>>
			<<addclass "body" "bg_night">>
		<</if>>
	<</if>>
<</if>>

    <<pic $tasha>>\
    <<art $tasha "happy,2">>\

passages.name: Tasha-JobChange2
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_SalesOffice>>\

    ''?tasha motions you inside and shuts the door behind her. She takes one of the seats in front her desk so as to sit close to you.''

    <<pic $tasha>>\
    <<art $tasha>>\

    <<nm $tasha "Okay, so... U-um...">>\

    <<nm $player "What's up ?tasha?">>\

    ''She's fidgetting anxiously as she tries to get the words out.''

    <<nm $tasha "I-I've been, um, going to Club Pearl a lot lately... Like a lot a lot... and...">>\

    ''Tears start to bead in the corners of ?tasha's eyes as she fights to continue her thought.''

    <<nm $tasha "Ahem, ?mc... I've decided to transfer over to club work.">>\

    <<nm $player "S-seriously?" "That's right, The Company owns Club Pearl, so it's technically a transfer...">>\

    <<nm $tasha "Yeah, I'm really excited about it! I'm gonna be a dancer there!">>\

    ''?tasha's eyes light up with excitement as she says this. She's clearly very happy about this. You take a deep breath.''

    <<nm $player "That's great ?tasha! I'm really happy for you!">>\

    <<nm $tasha "I'm so happy! Thank you for your support, ?mc. You get free private shows for SURE!">>\

    <<nm $player "How much longer will you be here?">>\

    ''?tasha hops over behind her computer and pulls up a calendar.''

    <<nm $tasha "I've got a couple days left. ?sophie told me if I'm gonna do this I need to get on it sooner than later... She seemed... annoyed...">>\

    <<Thought "I'm sure.">>\

    <<nm $player "Well, I'm sure you'll do great! Also, I'm really gonna miss you around here.">>\

    <<nm $tasha "Tee-hee! You know where to find me!">>\

    <<pic $tasha "kiss-player">>\
    <<act $tasha "kiss,player">>\

    ''?tasha pulls you in for a deep kiss before letting you go. She's clearly very excited about this.''

    <<btnLink "Continue" "Work" "passTime()">>\

passages.name: Tasha-OfficeBunny
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Lobby>>\
    <<SetFlag $tasha "OfficeBunny">>\

    ''You arrive at the office, surprised to see a small crowd has formed in a corner of the lobby.''

    <<Thought "What's going on over there?">>\

    ''Making your way over the crowd, you can see ?sophie and ?kagney standing nearby.''

    <<pic $sophie>>\
    <<art $sophie "angry,2">>\

    <<nm $sophie "This... this is why we need a dress code.">>\

    <<nm $kagney "Aww, I kinda like it!">>\

    ''Getting closer, you can finally see what all the fuss is about. ?tasha is standing in the corner of the room wearing a full Playboy bunny outfit, complete with fishnet stockings and a pair of bunny ears on her head.''

    /* ART Bunny Tasha CG */\
    <<nm $player "?tasha?">>\

    <<nm $tasha "Oh, heya ?mc! Whaddaya thing!?">>\

    ''?tasha turns around, showing off her outfit to you.''

    <<nmc "Random Employee" "Man, she's so fucking cute!">>\

    <<nmc "Horny Employee" "Hehe, think she fucks like a bunny too?">>\

    <<pic $tasha>>\
    <<art $tasha "happy,2">>\

    <<nm $tasha "Tee-hee! Do you love it? I figured, since I have the ears anyway, might as well bring a little of the club to the office! Everyone seems really happy with it!">>\

    <<nm $sophie "Not everyone!">>\

    <<nm $kagney "Don't mind her, you look great!">>\

    ''?sophie's finally had enough, making an effort to disperse the crowd before isolating ?tasha.''

    <<nm $sophie "?tasha... Why?">>\

    <<nm $tasha "Why... OH! The outfit? Tee-hee, well, I woke up one morning and these crazy rabbit ears were on my head, oh, and this cute little tail!">>\

    ''?tasha turns around and wiggles her butt in front of ?sophie.''

    <<nm $tasha "So I figured if I'm turning into a rabbit, I may as well finish the look, right? Speaking of looks...">>\

    ''?tasha saunters up closer to ?sophie, running a finger down her breast.''

    <<nm $tasha "You're looking... really tasty today... Can I be mommy's little slut bunny today?">>\

    ''?sophie, blushing furiously, slaps ?tasha's hand away.''

    <<nm $sophie "You need to get back to work! And if I find out this... whatever this is, is affecting your sales numbers, I'll see to it that your next office is a locked room downstairs!">>\

    ''She turns on her heel and storms off towards the elevator.''

    <<pic $kagney>>\
    <<art $kagney "aroused">>\

    <<nm $kagney "Well, I still like it! And, um... If you're still interested in being someone's slut bunny, you know where to find me, hehe!">>\

    ''As everyone goes back to what they were doing, you shrug your shoulders and go about your day as well.''

    <<Thought "This has to be from the MCS-X... Well, should make work a little more interesting anyway...">>\

    <<btnLink "Continue" "Work">>\

passages.name: Tasha-Quitting
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Lobby>>\
    <<set $tasha.isGone to true>>\
    <<set $tasha.isStripper to true>>\

    ''You arrive at the office like any other day, but this time there's something different. You start wandering around aimlessly, unable to quite put your finger on it, before it hits you like a truck.''

    <<Thought "Oh yeah...">>\

    ''You find yourself standing right in front of ?tasha's office, well, ?tasha's old office, anyway.''

    <<if $diana.isGone>>\
        <<pic $lauren>>\
        <<art $lauren "happy,2">>\

        <<nm $lauren "Looking for ?tasha? I just finished filing her transfer papers. Hahaha, man, I can't believe anyone would WANT to work over at that dump... Anyway, I wonder what ?john's up to...">>\

        ''?lauren walks off, the clicking of her heels echoing in the empty hallway.''
    <<else>>\
        <<pic $diana>>\
        <<art $diana "sad,2">>\

        <<nm $diana "Looking for ?tasha? Unfortunately you missed her. I just finished processing her transfer paperwork.">>\

        <<nm $player "I see...">>\

        ''?diana looks at you with a sad expression on her face.''

        <<nm $diana "I'm sorry, ?mc. I know you two were close. It is... odd that she would choose this for herself. Club Pearl is something of a collection bin for... middling employees.">>\

        <<Thought "I know why she chose this...">>\

        <<nm $player "Hard to say... At least I can visit her, though.">>\

        <<nm $diana "True enough.">>\

        ''?diana walks off, the clicking of her heels echoing in the empty hallway.''
    <</if>>\

    <<Thought "Well, guess this is it then. It's gonna be weird without her here...">>\

    ''You walk over to ?tasha's desk and sit down. You take a moment to look around, taking in the empty office. It's a little sad, but you know that ?tasha would want you to be happy. You take a deep breath and head back to your own work.''

passages.name: Menu-SubmitIssue
passages.source_raw:
''__Before Reporting An Issue:__'' Please read through the following notes before submitting an issue to the issue tracker. Thank you! ''__Missing Images__'' Please report if specific images are missing, including where you are in the game and what you were doing. If __all__ images are missing, please confirm that your game directory is correct. The game's html file should be in the same directory as the pics folder, but not IN the pics folder. Every release is tested to confirm images are working in both the online and offline versions of the game, so it's very unlikely that a bug is causing all images to fail to load. ''__Save Issues__'' Unfortunately, there are many factors that go into how the Twine engine handles save files which cannot be managed or troubleshooted by me. Most of these problems are browser-related. Please do not report these issues, as they are not something I can fix. If your save files are disappearing or simply not saving to begin, try playing on a different browser, or keep your save files locally. If your saves are not loading between major releases, this is intentional behavior. Any time a release updates major parts of the code or game structure, older saves are rendered invalid. ''__Spelling and Grammar__'' Reporting spelling and grammar issues is fantastic, please do this. When you do, please provide context as to where the issue is so I can locate it quickly. ''__Feature Requests__'' Please do not use the Report Issue function to make feature requests. Use the game's official discussion board at TFGS or on Discord.

passages.source_raw:
<<pic $npc "saya">>\
	<<art $saya "aroused,2">>\

	''The Company is a story-driven adult interactive fiction game that focuses on character customization, transformation, time management and meaningful choices. For the most part, everything is pretty easy to grasp, however, there are some nuances that you should be aware of before diving in!''

	''__Passage of Time__''
		Every day is broken up into 7 major blocks of time:
	
	* Morning
	* Late Morning
	* Noon
	* Early Afternoon
	* Afternoon
	* Evening
	* Night
	
	The vast majority of actions in the game will cause time to pass, and your day will need to be planned around how much time any one activity or interaction requires. Any action in the game that would cause time to pass will be proceeded with either a <<t1>> or a <<t2>> indicator, noting how many blocks of time will progress for taking that action. Going to sleep at night will always cause the day to end, taking you to the following morning.
	
	On work days, you'll arrive at The Company in the late morning, and get back home in the evening. You'll need to plan ahead to make the most of your limited time at both locations!
	
	''__Stats and Relationships__''
		You'll be able to cultivate Affection and Corruption with various characters you meet over the course of the game. Increasing these stats will rarely (though not never!) have impacts on the game itself, however, their importance will reveal themself later on.
	
	''__Gender__''
		Your gender is not a boolean value, but rather a sliding scale. While you've already decided on your starting gender, it's entirely possible for this to change drastically over the course of the game, between male, female and various in-between states!
	
	''__Sidebar__''
		All the aforementioned information can be tracked via the sidebar to the left. If you're playing The Company in a browser you'll see it at all times unless closed, however on a mobile device you'll need to tap the icon in the upper left corner. This is also where you can save, load and restart the game.
	
	''__Closing__''
		That's enough to get you going, but there's a lot more information that you'll need to discover on your own! Experiment, explore, and even when you think you've exhausted all available options keep poking around, you may even have to retrace your foot steps.
	
	Remember, there's no ==right== wrong way to play!

	<<btnLink "Hurray!" "Tutorial-End">>

passages.name: Story-CH3-MeetLauren
passages.source_raw:

''An announcement over the intercom, which up until now you didn't realize was something your office had, calls everyone into the main lobby where $sophie.name and an attractive woman you don't recognize are waiting. She's tall and thin, and carries herself with confidence. She seems a little nervous, though her large smile hides it well.''

<<pic $sophie>>\

<<nm $sophie "Thank you all for coming. As some of you may know, $diana.name has left our office to return to her responsibilities at Company Headquarters. Today, I would like to introduce her replacement...">>\

That said, I've been working as a records clerk both for The Company and other organizations for some time, so I'm confident I'll be able to contribute to the work we do here!">>\

''After her introduction, $lauren.name begins shaking hands with those near her while also intermittently chatting with $sophie.name. $tasha.name and $john.name are standing behind them in the hallway with neutral expressions on their faces. <<nm $julia "Ooohhhh, she's SEXY! Can't wait to eat that little cunt of hers... She's big, too, maybe she can take charge, hehe! How about you, $penny.name? Bet you can't wait to taste the new girl!">>\

<<nm $penny "$julia.name! Geez... Anyway, I don't know, it's weird not having $diana.name here...">>\

''$penny.name drifts off a little after that. She doesn't seem to be very attentive. Her distraction actually distracts you enough that you didn't even notice $lauren.name had made her way to you!''

<<nm $lauren "Hi, you must be $player.name! I've heard a lot about you!">>\

<<nm $player "H-huh? Oh, haha, yeah, nice to meet you. You've already heard about me? From $sophie.name?">>\

''$lauren.name giggles playfully.''

<<nm $lauren "Oh my!">>\

<<nm $player "Hm? I wasn't awar-">>\

''Your sentence is cut off quickly by $penny.name's elbow now lodged in your ribcage.''

<<nm $player "Y-yep, big spill, real bad, no visitors...">>\

<<nm $lauren "Aw, that's a shame. Another time then. Anyway, I'm gonna go get settled. Come by and visit some time, okay?">>\

''You wave each other off and $lauren.name heads for the records office as the crowd disperses. Meanwhile, you turn to $penny.name as you clutch your side.''

<<nm $player "Gonna tell me what that was about?">>\

passages.name: Story-CH3-Sean
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Lab>>\

''The two of you hurry into the lab and $penny.name quickly closes and locks the door behind you.''

<<nm $player "You're acting a little suspicious...">>\

<<pic $penny>>\

<<nm $penny "Haha, yeah, well, follow me...">>\

''Your laboratory is deceptively large. While the front area is full of workspaces, desks, sinks, and everything you'd expect to see in a chemistry lab, the back area includes a couple narrow hallways that connect to a number of large, walk-in coolers and storage closets. Normally you have no real reason to go back there, but that's exactly where $penny.name is leading you.''

<<nm $player "Hm, feels like I haven't been back here in a while...">>\

<<nm $penny "Nope! I always try to have everything stocked and prepped in the lab so you don't have to... Ah! Here we are! Sooooooo, here's the deal...">>\

<<nm $player "You're making me a little nervous, $penny.name.">>\

<<nm $player "You wanted to use him as a lab rat... He's in there, isn't he?">>\

''$penny.name starts rocking on her heels before opening the door. On the floor is a naked, older man. He's in fairly great shape for someone who looks to be in their early 50's, his hair still even retains its blond color. He's bound, gagged, and appears to be sedated.''

''$penny.name smiles wide.''

<<nm $penny "I had this crazy idea, right, where like, what if we could take all the collateral, y'know, guys like him who The Company would otherwise just 'deal with' mafia style, and turn them into something more useful!">>\

''You look at the scar on your hand from last month.''

	<<nm $penny "Exactly!">>\
<</if>>\

<<nm $penny "So here's what I have so far... I have the basic idea outlined, but I can't quite work out the specifics, or how all the parts will need to interact with each other to get to where I want to go...">>\

''You thumb through the notes.''

<<nm $player "You want to make him younger, submissive, induce feminine traits... Basically, instead of throwing him out, so to speak, you want to turn him into a sex slave?">>\

''$penny.name's breathing starts to intensify as her breathing becomes heavier. She's clearly getting aroused by her own idea.''

<<nm $penny "I asked her but she didn't say. All she told me was if we don't have any valuable progress to report then she's going to have to scrap our side project entirely... Maybe she's testing us?">>\

<<Thought "Maybe... Or maybe she's under pressure from the central office after the incident with $julia.name... Still, this is a fantastic idea, but it's going to need a lot of materials...">>\

''You hand $penny.name back her notes.''

<<nm $player "We'll need a dose of the CMD-1 we used on $tory.name, at least two full doses of the BMB-1 serum we used on $julia.name, and of course a solid three doses of TFM-1. That, combined with the notes you've put together, will at least get us to a point where we can show $sophie.name that the project has merit. If you can work on putting together the equipment and resources that you've documented here, I'll handle the serums.">>\

<<nm $penny "YES! This is gonna be great, boss! I'll get to work right away!">>\

''$penny.name bundles up her notes and runs to the back, presumably to get started on her task. Meanwhile, you reflect on what you'll need to do...''

    ''You do as you're told, taking a seat next to $sophie.name who, incidentally, is looking just as nervous as you are right now.''

    <<nm $lisa "Very good! Judging by the look on your face, I'll go ahead and assume that you weren't told I would be stopping by today. That's okay. $sophie.name, would you care to explain the situation?">>\

    ''$sophie.name clears her throat before quickly collecting herself and turning towards you.''

    <<nm $sophie "O-of course. $player.name, I'm not sure if you knew this or not, but $tory.name's official position within The Company was Sales and Acquisitions Executive. She was-">>\

    <<nm $lisa "$tory.name was effectively our head of sales.">>\

    ''$sophie.name meekly sinks into her chair after being cut off by her superior. You've never seen her quite as submissive as you have today, and it has you just a little concerned. $lisa.name continues.''

    <<nm $lisa "Her sudden... departure... has left us with a bit of a hole in upper management. While there haven't been any major issues yet, it's only a matter of time before spreading our resources too thinly at the top levels causes us to overlook something important.">>\

    <<nm $player "Something like sending down a ginger psychopath to manage our books and create an army of empenised sex zombies?">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Hahahahahaha! Oh my, you didn't tell me <<he>> was so feisty, $sophie.name. Mmmm, I like this one. Please, it's quite alright, everyone relax.">>\

    ''You slowly turn back around to face $lisa.name as $sophie.name once again sinks into her chair, somehow appearing smaller and smaller with every passing moment.''

    <<nm $lisa "Yes! It's exactly as you say. $lauren.name is the unfortunate product of a major power struggle currently escalating among the Executives. What's particularly interesting, is that this facility has somehow become something of a battleground.">>\

    <<Thought "I mean, things have been pretty batshit crazy since I came on, so... makes sense I guess?">>\

    <<nm $sophie "$tory.name's little coup back in September, $diana.name getting recalled to HQ and replaced with $lauren.name, and I daresay even the incident with $julia.name, were all plays made by one of the Executives.">>\

    ''$lisa.name nods along quietly with $sophie.name recounting, an amused smile on her face. You're a little surprised to see how different the two women are from each other. From your very brief meeting with $lisa.name in October, you were expecting someone a little more severe.''

    <<nm $player "Hey, um, something's been bothering me about, well, I guess all of this?">>\

    ''$lisa.name perks up excitedly.''

    <<nm $lisa "Is that a fact? Excellent! You know, only smart <<boy>>s actually think to ask questions. Please, what's on your mind?">>\

    ''You swallow hard, suddenly feeling like you've been put on the spot.''

    <<nm $player "W-well, u-um... Excuse me. So I mean, regardless of what it is The Company deals in, it's still a business, right? When you boil it down it's ran and operated like any other business in the world. Hell, I bet there's even an HR department somewhere.">>\

    ''$lisa.name maintains her smile, happily nodding along in agreement.''

    <<nm $player "Well, the way you're talking right now makes it seem like there's no centralized management or something. Like, in a normal organization this kind of sneaking around and ‘vying for power' or whatever would never be allowed to happen. I know there's a CEO in charge, so... If they wanted employees moved around, or branch offices decommissioned or resources redirected, then that's what would happen, right? I'm just having a hard time understanding how a business can operate this way.">>\

    ''$sophie.name is giving you a surprisingly impressed look, something that you can't help but interpret as "Oh, so you're not as dumb as you look". You're not quite sure how you feel about that. $lisa.name finally takes on a slightly more serious expression, though only just slightly.''

    <<nm $lisa "Mmm, not bad, <<Formal>>, not bad, but I think you're grossly undervaluing just how abnormal this business really is. Or rather, perhaps you don't quite understand how the management hierarchy works within The Company. $sophie.name, let's see how well you've been paying attention! Please, try to explain it to your protege won't you?">>\

    <<pic $sophie>>\

    <<nm $sophie "Y-yes, thank you. Well, it's really not too complicated, honestly, it's just not what one would consider ‘normal' when compared to other, successful businesses. The CEO does in fact have final say when it comes to any projects being approved. Any major funding requests that fall out of a division's budget must be approved by the CEO as well. Ultimately, they steer the ship in their desired direction.">>\

    ''She pauses for a moment, considering how best to move forward.''

    <<nm $lisa "Oh I do love a good nautical metaphor!">>\

    <<nm $sophie "A-anyway, the thing is, it's an extremely large ship, such that the Board of Executives was formed to operate various aspects of The Company with nearly complete autonomy. Sometimes, this means different divisions will achieve some level of overlap with each other. For example, $lisa.name acts as the current Infrastructure and Logistics Executive, however that hasn't stopped us from establishing a small R&D office without this branch. Approval for that had to come from the CEO, and of course approval to seek approval had to come from $lisa.name.">>\

    <<nm $player "I'm guessing that departments within the major divisions have a similar level of autonomy as the primary divisions themselves then.">>\

    ''$lisa.name's smile grows just a little wider.''

    <<nm $lisa "Oh $sophie.name, I'm so happy you found a smart one. Yes, $player.name, that's quite right. Ultimately, the CEO has final say in anything that would have a major impact on The Company as a whole, while the Executives hold that same position over their respective divisions. That said, it would be quite troublesome to involve our esteemed CEO in every little quarrel, so... If one division has something that another one wants...">>\

    <<nm $player "It's on those departments and divisions to achieve their goals however they see fit, so long as it doesn't negatively impact the entire organization. Is that about right?">>\

    <<nm $lisa "However they see fit, you've got it.">>\

    ''The room goes quiet as everyone starts to process the implications of what's just been discussed. Finally, you decide to speak up.''

    <<nm $player "I think that explains a lot... Thank you. So is that why you're here? Making you next move, or...">>\

    <<nm $lisa "In a way, I suppose. Like I said earlier, $tory.name's incident left a hole in upper management, a hole I've been so graciously voluntold to fill. This has pulled my attention away from my favorite manager and her new pet, but since I'm effectively the interim sales exec now it gives me a pretty compelling reason to visit more often.">>\

    <<nm $sophie "That reminds me, our meeting with $john.name and $tasha.name is coming up very soon.">>\

    ''$lisa.name checks her watch, a little shocked at home much time has gone by.''

    <<nm $lisa "Well, I'm glad we finally had the chance to really sit down and talk, <<Formal>>. You should expect to see me around much more often from now on, in fact, I should have an office set up soon enough. I think that's all I have for you. $sophie.name?">>\

    <<nm $sophie "No, I don't have anything else for this meeting. $player.name, you and I will catch up later so I can explain $lisa.name's role in our usual day to day.">>\

    ''The three of you all stand up from the table as $sophie.name moves to open the door.''

    <<nm $player "Thank you. Nice to meet you, $lisa.name.">>\

    <<nm $lisa "And you, $player.name.">>\

    ''You take your leave, quickly making your way back to the elevator.''

    <<Thought "Why do I get the feeling things are about to get a lot crazier around here than they already are...">>\

    <<AddWorkEvent 34>>\

    ''You walk downstairs to the kitchen and find $elsa.name and $sister.name sitting at the breakfast table slouched over their coffee with another pot already brewing. You grab a mug and wait for the coffee maker to finish before joining them at the table.''

    <<pic $sister>>\

    <<nm $sister "Morning...">>\

    <<nm $elsa "Good morning...">>\

    <<nm $player "Morning.">>\

    <<if $CH4.fuckOrgy>>\
        ''The three of you pass around knowing smiles, thinking back on the events of the previous night.''

        <<pic $elsa>>\

        <<nm $elsa "So... Last night was fun... That a normal occurrance around here?">>\

        <<nm $sister "Mmm, not normal enough!">>\

        ''You can feel both girls' hands running along your thighs, prompting a tired giggle from everyone at the table.''        
    <<elseif $CH4.fuckElsa>>\
        ''You and $elsa.name exchange knowing smiles, thinking back on the previous night.''

        <<pic $elsa>>\

        <<nm $elsa "Sleep well, $player.name?">>\

        <<nm $player "Like the dead. Must've been worn out from... dinner...">>\

        ''$sister.name is too tired to even notice the flirting.''

        <<nm $sister "$mom.name and I stayed up and finished off the wine... My head's still pounding...">>\
    <<else>>\
        ''You sip your coffee, noticing the other girls are a little worse for wear.''

        <<pic $elsa>>\

        <<nm $elsa "After you went to bed, the three of us decided to polish off the wine. Dude, your <<mom>> is a fucking monster! Drank $sister.name right under the table.">>\

        <<nm $sister "And right into a hangover...">>\
    <</if>>\
    
    <<nm $player "$mom.name not up yet?">>\

    <<nm $sister "That crazy woman left hours ago to go shopping!">>\

    <<nm $elsa "Holy shit! I mean, is Black Friday even worth it anymore?">>\

    <<nm $player "Nothing's worth getting up at 4 AM...">>\

    ''$sister.name holds up her mug in agreement.''

    <<nm $player "So, what's on our agenda today, then?">>\

    <<nm $elsa "Well, I gotta get packed. Plane leaves at 6:45 tonight and I still need to call in a ride.">>\

    <<nm $sister "What? Really? I didn't realize you were leaving so soon...">>\

    ''Your <<sister>>'s head falls into $elsa.name's shoulder as she wraps her arms her.''

    <<nm $sister "Don't goooooooo!!!!!">>\

    <<nm $elsa "Hahaha, after the week I've had, I'll definitely make it a point to come back!">>\

    <<if $ElsaScore < 50>>\
        ''You lean back in your chair, sipping at your coffee, when a sinister thought crosses your mind.''

        <<Thought "$elsa.name would make a fantastic guinea pig, I'm sure I could get $sophie.name to have her picked up... But then... Hmm... <<if seenConvo($sophie,9)>>Then again, maybe she could even get her a job at the front desk with $kagney.name...<</if>>">>\
    <<else>>\
        ''You lean back in your chair, sipping at your coffee.''

        <<Thought "Hmm, too bad, it was really nice having her around...">>\
    <</if>>\

    <<btnLink "Continue" "Home" "passTime()">>

passages.name: Story-CH4-ElsaLeave
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Landing>>\
    <<set $ElsaVisiting to false>>\

    <<pic $elsa>>\

    <<nm $elsa "Well, it's that time.">>\

    ''The four of you are all gathered at the front door, $elsa.name standing next to her luggage while $sister.name and your <<mom>> fight back tears.''

    <<pic $mom>>\

    <<nm $mom "Please come back and visit again, okay?">>\

    <<nm $sister "Yeah seriously!<<if $CH4.fuckOrgy>> Next time we can all marathon fuck for a whole week!<</if>>">>\

    <<nm $elsa "Hehe, you know it!">>\

    <<if $ElsaScore > 50>>\
        <<SetFlag $player "CallElsa">>\
        ''$elsa.name turns to you and wraps her arms around you. As she does, you can feel her slip a piece of paper down the back of your <<bottom>> before gently nibbling on your ear.''

        <<nm $elsa "Keep in touch, okay?">>\

        <<nm $player "Sure thing...">>\

        ''She finally frees you from her embrace and the four of you stand around the doorway waiting for $elsa.name's Uber to text her. After a few minutes or so it's time for her to go.''

        <<nm $elsa "Alright, that's me! I love you all, can't wait to see you again!">>\

        <<pic $sister>>\

        <<nm $sister "Come back soon!">>\

        ''After another quick round of goodbyes, $elsa.name takes her bags and leaves the house. The three of you stand around awkwardly for a moment before your <<mother>> speaks up.''

        <<nm $mom "Well... Now I'm sad... Who wants pizza?">>\

        <<nm $sister "Let's eat our feelings!">>\

        <<nm $player "Yep...">>\

        <<btnLink "Continue" "Home" "passTime()">>\
    <<else>>\
        <<Thought "Well, moment of truth. I can text $sophie.name right now or just, I guess, 'not' sentence my cousin to a life of sexual experimentation...">>\

        <<if seenConvo($sophie,9)>>\
            <<btnChoice "@@Text $sophie.name and have $elsa.name picked up to work for The Company@@" "ElsaLeave-FrontDesk">>
        <</if>>\
        <<btnChoice "Text $sophie.name and have $elsa.name sent to The Pit" "ElsaLeave-Pit">>
        <<btnChoice "Let it go and tell $elsa.name goodbye" "ElsaLeave-Free">>
    <</if>>\

<<loc_Lobby>>\

    ''As you enter the lobby, you're more than a little takenaback at the sight of $elsa.name and $kagney.name laughing and chatting together at the front desk. Despite the fact that you're the one directly responsible for it, it's still something that will take some getting used to.''

    ''$kagney.name bounces out of her seat.''

    <<nm $kagney "She's staying with me! Got her all moved in over the weekend and we've been having tons of fun together!">>\

    <</if>>\

passages.name: Story-CH4-ErikVisit
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Lobby>>\
    <<set $erik.name to "????">>\

    ''Walking through the lobby, you're more than a little surprised to see the elevator doors open in front of you. Typically, around this time, people are on their way out, not in.''

    <<Thought "Hm? Someone forget something...?">>\

    ''Out of the elevator steps a heavyset man in a brown suit. He saunters out into the lobby, hands in his pockets and a relaxed expression on his wide face. His calm composure betrays a kind of oppressing confidence just beneath the surface. Though you've never met this man, the way he carries himself screams "Executive". Since you were on your way towards the elevator to begin with, you're also the first thing he notices walking in.''

    <<pic $erik>>\

    <<nm $erik "Mmm, let's see... Based on the reports, you must be $player.name. Well, am I right?">>\

    <<nm $player "Y-yes, that's me." "Shit!">>\

    <<nm $erik "Ha, nailed it! Dr. Klein has told me so much about you since your visit. You really must've left some impression.">>\

    <<nm $player "Is that so?" "I was right, he's definitely an executive.">>\

    ''Even though he's standing still, it feels like he's towering higher and higher over you. You begin to feel uneasy, but before you loses your senses completely a hand on your shoulder snaps you back to reality, and a warm whisper in your ear calms you down.''

    <<pic $diana>>\

    <<nm $diana "Ah, Mr. Graves. I wish you would have given us more notice so we could have shown you a proper greeting. I've notified $sophie.name and $lisa.name of your arrival, and they will be down any second now." "@@.tf;Easy now, <<Formal>>...@@">>\
    <<set $erik.name to "Mr. Graves">>\

    ''As if on cue, the elevator doors open again, this time with your boss and her boss stepping off of it. Normally, you would find yourself feeling much more comfortable with $sophie.name by your side, but the grim expression on her face has you maintaining your guard.''

    <<nm $erik "Ah, my three favorite ladies all in the same room with me! Could I be any luckier...">>\

    <<pic $sophie>>\

    <<nm $sophie "Mr Graves, how wonderful to have you pay us a visit, s-sir. It's been some time since we've had you here.">>\

    ''$sophie.name is clearly flustered, trying her best to maintaining her composure.''

    <<pic $lisa>>\

    <<nm $lisa "If I recall, the last time you dragged your sorry ass down here was when $diana.name was originally assigned to us.">>\

    <<Thought "Holy shit, $sophie.name and $lisa.name seem to have completely different relationships with this guy!">>\

    ''The large man laughs off $lisa.name's quip before focusing his gaze on $diana.name. You feel her hand tense around your shoulder.''

    <<nm $erik "That's right, my how time flies... Actually, that's what I'm here for. I wanted to make sure my precious $diana.name was reacclimating well, and, of course, to apologize for all the chaos $lauren.name caused. You can imagine my surprise!">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Hmph, I can 'only' imagine it... So you slithered all the way from HQ just to check up on your former rat and apologize for your caged one? Sounds like you don't have enough work to keep you busy, and here I thought blowing James was taking up all your free time...">>\

    ''$erik.name doesn't laugh this time, instead only flashing $lisa.name a sinister smile as he started back towards the elevator.''

    <<nm $erik "Y'know, I'm not sure if you ever got a copy of the report... When we raided $lauren.name's apartment after the whole... incident... do you know what we found?">>\

    ''Silence.''

    <<nm $erik "She had apparently 'borrowed' our lab facility to take some young girl, replace her arms and legs with prosthetic cat limbs, bolt on a pair of ears and do who knows what else to her... Looked like she was keeping her as a pet! Poor thing looked like it'd starved to death by the time we got to her, though...">>\

    ''$erik.name entered the elevator, holding the door open.''

    <<nm $lisa "And your point, Erik? We all knew $lauren.name was sick.">>\

    <<nm $erik "Hm? Oh, no point, really... Just thinking it might be nice to own a cat... Anyway, I'll see you all around!">>\

    ''Before $lisa.name could respond, the doors slammed shut. You only just now noticed $diana.name's hand was still latched onto your shoulder, trembling. $sophie.name cleared her throat loudly, loud enough to refocus everyone's attention on her.''

    <<pic $sophie>>\

    <<nm $sophie "Well, that was unpleasant... Should we expect to see him showing up uninvited again, $lisa.name?">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Not likely... I'm sure just this quick visit will be heavily scrutinized by HQ. What a piece of shit, making a whole show just to throw his own sense of self importance in everyones' face!">>\

    <<nm $sophie "Maybe... It felt a little more threatening than that to me. On that note, are you okay, $diana.name?">>\

    ''$diana.name removes her hand from your shoulder, straightening herself up.''

    <<pic $diana>>\

    <<nm $diana "No reason I shouldn't be, ma'am. I think I'll head home for a warm bath and perhaps a, mmm, fresh meal... $player.name, won't you please walk me to my ride?">>\

    <<nm $player "O-of course!">>\

    ''With that, the four of you exit the lobby. $diana.name offers a flirty peck on your cheek as she steps into her vehicle, leaving you to find yours. By the time you get home you feel thoroughly exhausted, physically and mentally.''

    <<Thought "Just need to shake it off long enough to get through the night... Seriously, what the fuck WAS that!? He's obviously close to Dr. Klein, which probably makes him just as much of a scumbag... I'm sure $sophie.name will have something to say about it sooner rather than later.">>\

    ''You quietly enter your house.''

    <<btnLink "Continue" "Home" "setTime('night')">>

passages.name: Story-CH4-JamesAndErik
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_CompanyHQ>>\

    ''A large businessman and a lithe doctor sit across from each other at a nice bar. The doctor is leaning back with a nearly burnt out cigarette when a young waitress brings them both a large glass stein of a light colored frothy beer. They relax, drinking about half their beverages, before the doctor leans over the table.''

    <<nm $james "So, how was your little trip?">>\

    <<nm $erik "Not terribly eventful. Lisa was her usual ray of sunshine... though it was nice to see Sophie and $diana.name pretend like they weren't terrified of me again! Hahahaha!">>\

    ''$erik.name take another drink.''

    <<nm $james "Sounds about right... And the <<boy>>, did you get a chance to meet <<him>>?">>\

    <<nm $erik "Briefly... <<His>> cheerleading squad burst onto the scene before I could really size <<him>> up.">>\

    ''$james.name leans back in his seat, staring at the tall building across the street.''

    <<nm $james "Now that Lisa's so heavily involved, we can't just freely do as we please...">>\

    <<nm $erik "We're going to have to remove her from the board.">>\

    ''Both men sigh heavily before reaching for their glasses.''

    <<nm $james "Making most people dissappear isn't a problem at all, hell, it's practically our job... But if another exec goes missing it's going to have all of HQ up in arms, nevermind the fact that we're talking about the old man's favorite girl here. So, Erik, what do we do here?">>\

    ''$erik.name thinks for a moment before responding.''

    <<nm $erik "I suppose the obvious answer is that we get rid of the old man.">>\

    <<nm $james "There it is! Good, so you just keep doing your part and try to keep Lisa from being any more of a problem than she needs to be. I'll see to my task in the meantime.">>\

    <<nm $erik "My my, so confident! Well, I'll leave it to you then.">>\

    ''$james.name lights a new cigarette and orders another round of drinks...''

    <<btnLink "Continue" "Room-Sleep">>

passages.name: Story-CH4-ConferenceCall
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_SophieOffice>>\

    ''Stepping off the elevator, you inadvertently find yourself on $sophie.name's floor. Her office door is open and the light is off, but you immediately notice voices coming from the conference room across the hall. What's particularly jarring is the strong, stern voice of an old man blasting through the speaker phone.''

    <<Thought "Shit, did I get off on the wrong floor? Wait, what are they...">>\

    ''Without thinking, you quietly move up to the slightly cracked door. Now that you're closer, you can tell that $lisa.name's in there with $sophie.name, and they're both talking to at least one other person on the phone.''

    <<Thought "$sophie.name will kill me if she catches me, probably literally, but then again, information is power here...">>\

    ''You move closer to the door, making it a point not to be heard.''

    <<Thought "That big guy from the other day is in there, too.">>\

    <<pic $lisa>>\

    <<nm $lisa "...So basically, you're keeping me on glorified babysitting duty, right?">>\

    <<pic $sophie>>\

    <<nm $sophie "Wow, tell me how you really see me...">>\

    <<nm $erik "SOMEONE has to keep an eye on you, and frankly I wish it was me.">>\

    ''The other voice crackles over the speaker phone.''

    <<nmc "Old Man" "That's enough, all of you! Erik, you will continue to oversee Dr. Klein's project. There are a lot of moving parts and it seems we've become short staffed in the administration department.">>\

    <<nm $erik "Yes sir...">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Would you like me to go ahead and update our contact out here?">>\

    <<nmc "Old Man" "Oh right... Have they finished relocating?">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Yes, about three months ago now.">>\

    <<nmc "Old Man" "If you would please update them, yes. Is there anything else?">>\

    <<nm $lisa "No sir.">>\

    <<nm $erik "Nope.">>\

    ''A pause.''

    <<nmc "Old Man" "Sophie?">>\

    <<nm $sophie "N-no sir, there's nothing else. So, that'll conclude our meeting then?">>\

    ''$sophie.name asked her question in an unnaturally loud tone, as if to ensure you could hear her.''

    <<Thought "Shit, they're wrapping up! I should get out of here...">>\

    <<nm $erik "Geez, that excited to blow us off, huh?">>\

    <<nmc "Old Man" "Yes, that concludes our meeting. Thank you all, I know these are difficult times so I appreciate the hard work.">>\

    ''You manage to make your way back into the elevator before anyone leaves the room.''

    <<btnLink "Continue" "Work">>

passages.name: Story-CH4-OverhearLisa
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Lobby>>\

    ''As you step off the elevator, you run into $sophie.name catching up with $kagney.name in the lobby. She wraps up her conversation and turns towards the elevator before getting quickly pulled aside by $lisa.name.''

    <<pic $lisa>>\

    <<nm $lisa "Sophie, quick question for you... Why did you assign me additional security detail? You know I prefer keeping my own, personal staff around me.">>\

    <<pic $sophie>>\

    <<nm $sophie "I'm sorry, I'm not sure what you're talking about?">>\

    ''$lisa.name pauses for a moment.''

    <<nm $lisa "You didn't assign any of your people to watch me?">>\

    <<nm $sophie "No ma'am, that would be in poor taste, don't you think? Wait...">>\

    ''The girls lean in, taking a hushed tone as you walk by trying not to look like you're listening in.''

    <<nm $sophie "Do you think you're being followed? Erik?">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Can't say, but... We'll talk about this later.">>\

    ''$sophie.name and $lisa.name give each other a confirming nod before quickly heading their separate ways. $sophie.name gives you a quick glance as well, almost as if to confirm that you overheard them.''

    <<Thought "Things are getting intense around here...">>\

    <<btnLink "Continue" "Work">>\

passages.name: Story-CH4-JagMeeting
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Diner>>\

    ''The three of you arrive at the diner and pile into a small booth in the corner. $mick.name and $jag.name sit across from you, and you all order a round of coffee, $jag.name requesting the pot be left at the table.''

    <<nm $jag "Heya, thanks for taking the time to talk to me!">>\

    <<nm $player "Oh, no worries man, any time. What's up?">>\

    ''$jag.name pours himself a cup of coffee and starts mixing in cream and sugar before taking a look around the room. As he turns back towards you, you're more than a little surprised to see your friend, $chris.name, walking through the door and taking a seat at the counter. While he doesn't seem to notice you, $jag.name catches your facial expression before quickly glancing behind him.''

    <<nm $jag "Hm? You know that guy?">>\

    <<if flag($chris,"Reunion")>>\
        <<nm $player "Oh, yeah, he's an old friend of mine from college. We've been hanging out again recenting.">>\

        <<nm $jag "Hunh, well good on you for keeping up with friends!">>\
    <<else>>\
        <<nm $player "Kinda, he's an old friend of mine from college. We haven't really kept in touch, though.">>\

        <<nm $jag "Ah.">>\
    <</if>>\

    ''You turn your attention back to $jag.name.''

    <<nm $player "Sorry about that, go ahead.">>\

    <<nm $jag "Right, right, so... Look, you ever been workin' a job for a while, and you just start to, like, get this vibe that things are sorta, like, I dunno... $mick.name, help me out.">>\

    <<nm $mick "Hmmm...">>\

    <<nm $jag "Yeah, exactly, like things are starting to take a major downhill turn an' you're 'probably' about to get fired.">>\

    ''You sip at your coffee and think about it for a moment.''

    <<nm $player "Haven't really worked that many jobs, but, yeah I think I understand what you're saying... Do you think you're going to get fired?">>\

    <<nm $jag "Ha, boy I wish... You know nobody in this joint gets 'fired', right? Best case scenario they literally set you fire.">>\

    <<Thought "He makes a good point...">>\

    <<nm $player "I hear you... What do you need from me?">>\

    ''$jag.name flags the waitress down for another pot of coffee.''

    <<nm $jag "Honestly, I dunno. I wouldn't be so worried about it 'cept I just found out I'm definitely bein' followed around town... Like, as soon as we drop you off in the morning I'm gettin' tailed everywhere I go! Makin' me nervous just to look out my window in the morning. Hey, $mick.name, you hungry? Breakfast here actually looks pretty good!">>\

    ''$mick.name grunts indifferently, prompting $jag.name to order three omelettes with bacon.''

    <<nm $player "I, uh...">>\

    <<nm $jag "Nah, I got you! You heard me out, lemme buy you breakfast. I'm sure we'll come up with somethin'...">>\

passages.name: Story-CH4-LisaMission
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Lobby>>\

    ''As you exit the elevator, you're more than a little surprised to see $lisa.name and $penny.name standing in the middle of the lobby, seemingly waiting for you.''

    <<pic $penny>>\

    <<nm $penny "$player.name! Good morning!">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Ah, there you are. Come on you two, we're going to have a little chat upstairs!">>\

    <<nm $player "I, um... Good morning?">>\

    ''You step to the side, allowing $penny.name and $lisa.name to board the elevator first before following them inside. $lisa.name presses the button for the executive floor, and a few moments later the three of you find yourselves in an empty conference room.''

    <<pic $lisa>>\

    <<nm $lisa "$penny.name, if you wouldn't mind closing the door. Now then, I wanted to talk about what happened to $tory.name a few months ago.">>\

    <<nm $player "R-right, about that...">>\

    ''$lisa.name starts laughing.''

    <<nm $lisa "No, no... No need to apologize, frankly I thought it was brilliant. Actually, what I wanted to talk to about was the how of it all. I understand the serum used on $tory.name was developed by you two in the lab?">>\

    <<pic $penny>>\

    <<nm $penny "Yep! $player.name worked on that one. We call it our $serum[4].name serum.">>\

    <<if $story.makeCMD1>>\
        <<nm $player "Yep, we were able to get that made just in time for the meeting.">>\
    <<else>>\
        <<nm $player "Yeah, actually we wouldn't have been able to pull that off without $penny.name coming in clutch.">>\

        <<nm $penny "Hehe, I try!">>\
    <</if>>\

    ''You and $penny.name recount the event from your perspective while $lisa.name listens intently.''

    <<nm $lisa "Okay, so let me ask you something. Have you two continued development on the $serum[4].name serum since then?">>\

    <<nm $player "Not exactly, we were pretty happy with the effect at that point.">>\

    <<nm $lisa "I see... Okay, do you think it would be possible to create a version of this particular serum, specifically allowing for direct control over the person, but without the intense change to libido and with more mental autonomy?">>\

    ''You and $penny.name sit back in your chairs and exchange some brief glances. $penny.name is the first to speak.''

    <<nm $penny "So you mean, like... Hold on, um...">>\

    <<nm $player "Sounds like you're basically wanting to be able to make sleeper agents or something...">>\

    <<nm $penny "Yeah, that's it! Haha, wow, this is some Tom Clancy bullshit. But I mean, it shouldn't be 'that' hard, right $player.name?">>\

    ''You look over at $lisa.name.''

    <<nm $player "Is this request coming from $james.name? Sounds like him.">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Hmph, no it most certainly is not coming from that man. No, this is a personal project of mine, and I'd like to keep the people who know about it as small as possible, ideally just us three.">>\

    ''$penny.name looks at you and shrugs.''

    <<nm $penny "The biggest problem right now is the supply chain. For what I think we'll need to get this working, I'm thinking... probably around the first of the year for something usable.">>\

    <<nm $player "That's about what I was thinking.">>\

    ''$lisa.name thinks for a moment.''

    <<pic $lisa>>\

    <<nm $lisa "That'll work, if you can get it to me before the end of January I think that'll be just fine. I'll be waiting!">>\

    ''$lisa.name stands and quickly heads for the door, bringing an abrupt end to your small meeting. You and $penny.name quickly stand and follow her out the door and into the elevator while she waits behind for $sophie.name.''

    <<nm $penny "Hey boss, this feels kinda crazy, yeah?">>\

    <<nm $player "Does it? There's been so much crazy lately that I almost didn't notice.">>\

    <<nm $penny "Good point! Haha, ha... hm...">>\

    ''The two of you head quietly back to the lab.''

    <<SetFlag $player "LisaMission">>\
    <<btnLink "Continue" "Work" "setTime('lm')">>

<<set $CanTF to false, $player.wakeup to "christmas">>\
    <<loc_Kitchen>>\

    ''Just as your <<mother>> starts putting together serveware for the roast she's been working on all day, the doorbell rings. You run over to answer it.''

    <<pic $chris>>\

    <<nm $player "$chris.name!">>\

    <<nm $chris "Hey hey! Merry Christmas, $player.name!">>\

    <<nm $mom "Alright everyone, sit down and serve up. We're eating good tonight!">>\

    <<if $chris.canRomance>>\

        <<nm $player "B-boyfriend?">>\

        ''$chris.name, clearly overhearing your <<sister>>, laughs to himself in the kitchen.''
    <<else>>\
        <<nm $sister "You know how $mom.name is, plus she probably missed having $chris.name over just as much as you did.">>\
    <</if>>\

    <<nm $chris "Oh yeah!">>\

    ''You're nearly scared out of your seat when $chris.name somehow appears behind you and yells into your ear.''

    <<nm $chris "Totally forgot I brought that wine! Ready to bust into it?">>\

passages.name: Story-CH4-FinishCMD2
passages.source_raw:
<<loc_Lab>>\

    ''You settle in after to work and start pulling together your notes regarding the specialty serum requested by $lisa.name. A few moments later, $penny.name enters the room and closes the door behind her.''

    <<pic $penny>>\

    <<nm $penny "Mornin' boss! Glad you're already here, I wanted to tell you I'd finished up my part for $lisa.name's request. How's your end coming along?">>\

    <<nm $player "Actually, great timing, I'm done, too!">>\

    <<nm $penny "Nice! Cool, so, I think all that's left at this point is the synthesizing process, right?">>\

    ''You nod, motioning for $penny.name to help you get the equipment set up. The two of you spend the rest of the morning finishing work on a single dose of concentrated serum.''

    <<nm $player "I think... It's done?">>\

    <<nm $penny "Looks like. Watcha gonna call it? Got any clever ideas?">>\

    ''You roll the vial in your hand for a moment, examining the light passing through it, before shrugging.''

    <<nm $player "CMD-2.">>\

    <<nm $penny "Lame.">>\

    <<nm $player "Yeah... Anyway, we should probably get this on ice, it'll take some time to stabilize.">>\

    <<nm $penny "Don't you wanna test it first?">>\

    ''You think for a second.''

    <<nm $player "Nah, as far as composition goes it's basically just a more condensed version of the CMD-1 serum... Plus Lenny's off today.">>\

    ''$penny.name glares at you.''

    <<nm $player "I'm kidding! I'll give $lisa.name a call and let her know it's done. We'll probably want to keep it in here and have her pick it up when she's ready for it.">>\

    <<nm $penny "Sounds like a plan, I'll get it in a locker.">>\

    ''$penny.name takes the vial to the back of the lab, locking it in chilled storage while you get $lisa.name on the phone.''

    <<nm $lisa "$player.name, what can I do for you?">>\

    <<nm $player "Hey, just wanted to let you know that $penny.name and I have finished with that thing you wanted. We're gonna hold it down here for you, is that okay?">>\

    ''There's a brief silence.''

    <<nm $lisa "That would be wonderful. I'll come by in a couple days, would that be alright?">>\

    <<nm $player "No problem, $penny.name or I will be here.">>\

    <<nm $lisa "Perfect, I'll see you soon.">>\

    ''$lisa.name hangs up the phone, you turn to $penny.name and give a thumbs up, which she acknowledges in kind.''

    @@.data;You've completed the CMD-2 for $lisa.name!@@

<<widget "Conversation">>
		<<set _actor to $args[0]>>
		<<set _link to "convo-" + $args[0].id>>
		<<for _i = 1; _i < _actor.convo.length; _i++>>
			<<set _convo to _actor.convo[_i]>>
			<<if convoEnabled(_actor,_i)>>
				<<if _convo.seen>>
					<<set _title to _convo.title>>
				<<else>>
					<<set _title to _convo.title + " - <<new>>">>
				<</if>>
				<<capture _convo>>
					<<btnChoice "_title" _link "$ConversationID = _convo.id">>
				<</capture>>
			<<else>>
				<<if $args[1] is true>>
					<<btnDisable "_convo.title">>
				<</if>>
			<</if>>
		<</for>>
	<</widget>>

	<<widget "NewConvoCheck">>
		<<set _actor to $args[0]>>
		<<set _isNew to "">>

		<<for _i = 1; _i < _actor.convo.length; _i++>>
			<<if convoEnabled(_actor,_i) is true and not seenConvo(_actor,_i)>>
				<<set _isNew to " - <<new>>">>

		<</for>>
